attrs.evidence: NONE, AND THIS RECORD EXISTS SO THAT ABSENCE HAS SOMEWHERE TO LIVE. GPT-5.6 ruled that `the algebra is executable` and `the algebra has ever bought anyone precision` are different claims and that carrying only the first hides the second. Every operational narrowing in this tree — three of them — is a DECLARED SYNTHETIC CONTROL written to execute a branch; no narrowing has ever been discharged against a real support edge, because no real support hypergraph exists. This is deliberately NOT folded into SUPPORT-REACH-CONSERVATIVE-TYPED, which is a conditional theorem about safety; this is a question about BENEFIT, and a safe analysis that never improves on its baseline is sound and useless. It stays unestablished until a real support edge receives a verified narrowing AND the worklist it shrinks is measured. IMPACT-PRECISION-FRONTIER makes the bar higher than it looked: a single narrowing is not enough, because one non-operational edge upstream sends the label to ⊤ and no downstream rule can recover it.
